What will you be eating 25 years from today?
Long ago, people wouldn’t have imagined that you could start your day with a bowl of corn flakes for breakfast, get
a sandwich on sliced bread from a drive-through window, or have a bag of potato chips for a snack. That makes us
wonder: How will the food we eat and the way we cook be different in 10 or 20 years from now?
